content:
Chem Progress is a dynamic and innovative chemical company based in Via Romagna 9, 20098 San Giuliano Milanese (MI), Italy. Strategically located in the heart of one of Italy’s most important industrial and logistics areas, the company serves as a reliable partner for manufacturers, distributors, and specialized users across multiple sectors, including coatings, plastics, detergency, textiles, metalworking, and industrial processing.

Founded with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and environmental responsibility, Chem Progress focuses on the development, formulation, and distribution of chemical products and specialties tailored to customers’ specific technical needs. Its portfolio may include raw materials, additives, intermediates, and customized blends designed to improve performance, optimize processes, and add value to finished products. The company places great emphasis on regulatory compliance and traceability, aligning its operations with European and international standards.

At the core of Chem Progress’s philosophy is a customer-oriented approach: technical support, application consulting, and flexible logistics are integrated into its service model. By working closely with clients, the company aims to identify the most suitable solutions, reduce costs, and enhance efficiency in production cycles. Continuous improvement, innovation, and the careful selection of suppliers and technologies enable Chem Progress to maintain a competitive edge while promoting safe and sustainable chemical applications.

From its base in San Giuliano Milanese, Chem Progress combines local know-how with a broader outlook, positioning itself as a trusted, forward-looking partner for the modern chemical industry.
